title: Trade review 18 Nov: 3 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 0 T1, 2 failed: FINCABLES −12.79% and VMM −6.01% at 30 days; INDIANB bought. 89 closed trades now total +153.2%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Wed 18 Nov:** FINCABLES and VMM failed at 30 days, INDIANB bought, and the run-up lesson weakens.

Two 30-day exits, both losses: −18.8 points together. All 89 closed trades now total +153.2% (average +1.7%), against +172.0% from 87 last night. Nifty fell 0.63% to 25,227.95. 14 trades are still running, 12 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 103 bought trades is +0.9%. One new pick was listed (UNIONBANK). The next 30-day exit is AEGISLOG (−10.7%) on 20 Nov, then GOODLUCK, PNGSREVA and ASTRAL on 23 Nov.

**Today's results**
- ❌ **FINCABLES** (Pullback, listed 16 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹1,360.00 on 19 Oct and it never rose above the fill (best rise 0.0%); closed at ₹1,186.00, −12.79% (worst −22.60%), 11.7% below its ₹1,342.75 support. The listing chart shows a stock that had already rallied about 50% from August on a huge volume spike, topped at the ₹1,498 wall, and then printed a change of character down with big red candles; it listed on only 0.4× volume with T2 (₹1,466) just under that wall. Zone bottom only would have softened it to −11.67%. It rose only 0.4% in the month before listing, because its run-up came in August and September, so the 1-month run-up check missed it.
- ❌ **VMM** (Candle at support, listed 16 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at ₹96.00 on 19 Oct, best rise +1.9%; closed at ₹90.23, −6.01% (worst −12.33%), 6% below its ₹95.99 support. The chart shows a year-long slide of lower highs and lower lows into a one-year low, a sweep under support and only 0.6× volume: a hammer in a falling stock, not a base. Zone bottom only would have lost the same (−6.00%). It is the third real candle-at-support failure, after CENTUM and WABAG; it fell 4.9% in the month before listing.
- 🟢 **INDIANB** (Candle at support, listed 17 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹933.90 today; the low came 0.3% inside the zone. Now +0.33%. F&O stock with a bullish engulfing candle, but it rose 12.1% in the month before listing, so it sits in the run-up group. It was a missed winner when listed on 12 Oct.

No wins closed today. Plus 60 earlier, among them IDFCFIRSTB, NMDC, SUNDARMFIN, PFC and TMPV (11 Nov). These 70 wins (55 at T2, 15 partial) made +353.5%; with the 19 failures (−200.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63%, SMLMAH −18.63% and today's FINCABLES −12.79%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 89 closed trades total +153.2%. 7 of the 15 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (6): GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 5 of these 6 are below their buy price (ASTRAL −10.4%, PNGSREVA −8.6%, ESCORTS −8.6%, GRANULES −0.4%, ONGC −0.04%).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Better prices inside the window did not help today:** Both failures kept falling after the entry window: zone bottom only would have lost −11.67% on FINCABLES and −6.00% on VMM.
- **Missed winners still 19 of 31:** None new tonight. 23 of the 31 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 94% vs 80% as listed: 13.9 points (the bar is 15). Its 106 closed trades made +182.9%, against +153.2% from 89 as listed, with 23 losing trades against 22.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.5% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.3 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 104 closed trades made +212.6% with 18 losing trades; average closed trade +2.0% against +1.7%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.3% (closed and open), and their 24 closed trades net −68.6% with 11 of the 19 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 15 retest near misses logged since then: 5 at T1, 4 at T2, best rise 3.9% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 13 of the 15 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing; today's FINCABLES (+0.4%) and VMM (−4.9%) are the first two that did not. Those 39 trades average −3.5% and their 32 closed trades net −106.4%; the other 64 made +259.6% from 57 closed trades, 42 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (weakening)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 42 bought reached T1 (88%) and 30 reached T2 (71%); their 36 closed trades made +172.0% with 4 failures (VMM today, CENTUM, WABAG and a flat LIQUIDBEES), and they dip least (−4.3%). (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 38 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (74%), worst dip −3.4%. 56 cash trades: 19 at T2 (34%), worst dip −11.5%. VMM is an F&O failure, but the gap is unchanged. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 19 of 31 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 23 of the 31 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small, about +3.9% each. (holding)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%. Early sign from today's two failures: both listed on weak volume (0.4× and 0.6×); 2 trades are not a pattern.

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+212.6% vs +153.2%), but its dip gain is 1.3 points against a bar of 2; zone up to 2% above gets 13.9 points more fills against a bar of 15. Neither would have saved today's two failures, which all four rules bought at about the same price.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 103 bought = 55 at T2 + 15 partial + 19 failed + 14 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only price change against last night is INDIANB's new fill.
